note: Painted flipbook sheets for the seven special archetypes (docs/specials.md). A sheet is a grid atlas (cols x rows, frames left to right, top to bottom) of white-on-transparent art: the game tints it per fighter and draws it additive. High: 16 frames of 256 px cells (4x4, 1024x1024). Low: 8 frames of 128 px cells (4x2, 512x256). A kind with no entry under `sheets` plays the procedural STAND-IN made in code (render/flipbook.ts). To ship real art, put the PNGs in Game/fx/flipbook/ and add { "high": { "file": "fx/flipbook/<kind>.png" }, "low": { "file": "fx/flipbook/<kind>-low.png" } } here: nothing else changes.
